findings.evidence: The building blocks already have these lemmas (`algEquivDualNumberOfDoubleRoot_omega` at DualNumber.lean:89, `algEquivDualNumberOfDoubleRoot_symm_apply` at :96, `quotientSpanNatCastEquiv_mk` at Reduction.lean:138); the new file declares no lemma about `quotientSpanTwoEquivDualNumber`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] quotientSpanTwoEquivDualNumber_mk` giving the image of `Ideal.Quotient.mk _ z` (as `z.re + z.im • (1 + ε)` reduced mod 2) or at least of `mk ω`, plus a `_symm_apply` lemma.
findings.issue: `quotientSpanTwoEquivDualNumber` has no evaluation lemma: the docstring claims `ω ↦ 1 + ε`, but nothing states it, and there is no `symm` lemma either, so any consumer must unfold the definition.

findings.evidence: `algEquivProdOfRoots_apply` and `algEquivProdOfRoots_symm_apply` exist (Split.lean:68, :76); no corresponding lemma is declared in IndexTwo.lean.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] quotientSpanTwoRingEquivProd_mk : quotientSpanTwoRingEquivProd a ha (mk z) = (z.re + z.im, z.re)` (cast to `ZMod 2`) and a `_symm_apply` lemma.
findings.issue: `quotientSpanTwoRingEquivProd` has the same gap: the docstring says it evaluates at the roots `1` and `0`, but there is no `_mk` or `_symm_apply` lemma.

findings.evidence: The declaration at line 96 has no attribute; only `re_algHomDiscrZero`, `im_algHomDiscrZero`, `quotientAlgHomDiscrZero_mk` and `quotientRingEquivDiscrZero_apply` are `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `algHomDiscrZero_omega` is the lemma giving the map's value on the generator, but it is not tagged `@[simp]`, so `simp` cannot rewrite `algHomDiscrZero a b hd he ω` without going through `ext`.

summary: The two new mod-2 ring equivalences have no lemmas for evaluating them, so consumers must unfold their definitions; the generator lemma `algHomDiscrZero_omega` is also not `@[simp]`. The rest of the `algHomDiscrZero`/`quotientAlgHomDiscrZero` API is complete and annotated, with no compatibility shims or exposed bodies.
